top_signals.title: Switzerland shortlists SAMP/T, Barak MX for long-range air defense
top_signals.summary: Switzerland narrowed down the choice of the country’s second future long-range air defense system to either Israel’s Barak MX system or the French-Italian SAMP/T NG.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hong Kong leader apologizes over deadly Tai Po blaze
top_signals.summary: Hong Kong’s leader John Lee issued a rare apology and said his housing secretary has stepped down over the city’s deadliest fire in decades. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Blue Owl Fees Beat Estimates Though Redemptions Weigh on Inflows
top_signals.summary: Blue Owl Capital Inc. reported a larger uptick in fees than analysts expected in the third quarter, though the private credit firm’s inflows were weighed down by investors seeking to redeem holdings in certain funds.
